messages:
Alex M: Heads up PR #9120 has a billing example that mixes list price + reserved discounts and might confuse customers.
Tess (docs): Paste the snippet?
Alex M: Current doc: 
```
Request: generate 200 tokens + 1 embedding
Generation: 200 * $0.00002 = $0.0040
Embedding: 1 * $0.0004 = $0.0004
Total = $0.0044
```
This ignores that the account has reserved capacity where generation gets a 20% discount and that token rounding occurs per-request.
Ravi B: We should show both list and post-discount numbers, and add a short SDK example mapping request -> meter events. Also note Console shows separate lines for generation vs embeddings.
Tess (docs): Proposed replacement: 
```
Worked example (illustrative):
Request: generate 200 tokens + 1 embedding
List: generation = 200 * $0.00002 = $0.004000
List: embeddings = 1 * $0.0004 = $0.000400
Subtotal (list) = $0.004400
Reserved discount (generation only, example 20%): generation discounted = $0.004000 * 0.8 = $0.003200
Total after discount = $0.003200 + $0.000400 = $0.003600 (~$0.0036)
Note: tokens rounded per request; final billed amounts depend on meter aggregation.
```
Alex M: SDK snippet for mapping: 
```js
const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rw-instruct-1', input: 'Summarize' });
// separate embedding call shows up as embeddings.units in billing
```
BillingBot: CI - docs/build passed (https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/9120) :white_check_mark: 
Ravi B: Small nit: label discount as "example" and link to the metering glossary for "token" and "embedding unit".
Tess (docs): Will update heading to "Mixed-workload billing example", add SDK snippet and a 3-row matrix clarifying which discounts typically apply. Ready to merge after CI.
